reel.caption:
Is a ₹1 lakh a month CTC really ₹1 lakh in your hand?

Illustrative ₹12 lakh CTC, ₹50k basic: employer PF ₹6,000 and gratuity ₹2,405 a month sit inside CTC but never reach your account.
From your gross, your own PF ₹6,000 and professional tax ₹200 (varies by state) come out.
Income tax is ₹0 here: in the new regime, taxable income up to ₹12 lakh after the ₹75,000 standard deduction pays none. Left in hand ≈ ₹85,395 a month.
Your PF is still your money, just not spendable this month. If PF is on the ₹25,000 wage ceiling, in-hand is higher.

How far apart were your CTC and your first salary credit?

Sources: a hiring platform's CTC-to-in-hand guide, a salary-calculator site's salary-structure guide and an FY 2026-27 tax explainer; the ₹ figures are our own arithmetic.
